name: Radarr
description: Radarr⁠ - A fork of Sonarr to work with movies à la Couchpotato.
composeYaml:
services:
  radarr:
    image: 'lscr.io/linuxserver/radarr:latest'
    environment:
      - _APP_URL=${APP_URL}
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - 'TZ=${TZ:-America/Toronto}'
    volumes:
      - 'radarr-config:/config'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://localhost:7878/ping'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15

meta.about: Automatically download movies via Usenet and BitTorrent (fork of Sonarr).
